title: %base64Encode - Base64-encode a string
purpose: Encode a UTF-8 string as Base64 text.
notes: The input is treated as UTF-8 before encoding, so non-ASCII text encodes its byte sequence.
The result is a plain string, not an ODIN binary (^) value.

avoid.why: a bare word encodes the literal text "content", not the field; use @.content
